subject: Secure SDLC: CI/CD secrets rotation evidence bundle for SIG assessor
messages:
From: security_assessor@acmefin.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: secrets rotation and CI/CD handover

Hi Ben,

Following our SIG questionnaire review, the assessor team needs a compact evidence bundle that demonstrates Redwood's ephemeral secrets rotation in CI/CD and the change-gate for keystore updates. Specifically we need: 1) the playbook/process owners and cadence for rotations; 2) example rotation logs for the last 90 days; 3) proof of CI/CD gating that prevented a deployment when keys were stale; and 4) the KMS key rotation audit (key IDs redacted if necessary).

Can you provide a scannable bundle by EOD Monday (7/14)? If parts require an internal reviewer first, flag that.

Thanks,
Lara Mendes
Lead Assessor, Acme FinServ Security
security_assessor@acmefin.com

---
Attachment: sig_request-form-20250710.pdf (pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: security_assessor@acmefin.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: secrets rotation and CI/CD handover

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear list. We're on it.

Quick plan: Monica will compile rotation logs and the KMS audit extract; Marissa will pull the CI/CD gating examples and the playbook; I will do a brief review and redact any key identifiers before delivery. Expect an initial bundle tomorrow morning and the full package by EOD Monday.

Couple of quick clarifying Qs:
- For "example rotation logs", do you need the full logs or a zipped sample filtered to rotation events? We prefer to supply a zipped sample with indexes.
- For the KMS audit, do you want the full event trail, or an export limited to rotate/create schedules?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
---
Internal note: tagging kimberly for keystore policy confirmation.

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: secrets rotation and CI/CD handover

Ben / team — attaching the artifacts I pulled. Files: ci-cd-rotation-playbook.pdf, rotation-logs-202504-202506.zip, kms-rotation-audit.csv. Highlights below for the assessor: 

- Playbook (ci-cd-rotation-playbook.pdf): describes roles (Secrets Steward, Build Eng), automated rotation cadence (30/90 day depending on secret class), and emergency rotation steps with rollback checks.
- Rotation logs (rotation-logs-202504-202506.zip): filtered to rotation events and contains trace IDs. Sensitive identifiers have been tokenized (see README in zip).
- KMS audit (kms-rotation-audit.csv): includes timestamp, principal, event (RotateKey/DisableKey), key alias (redacted alias_***).

I've run basic PII checks. The CI gating example Marissa requested (deployment_block_20250512.log) is in the zip under examples/. That event shows a blocked promotion due to a missing secret and the automated rollback trigger.

Please confirm any further redaction before I send externally.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: ci-cd-rotation-playbook.pdf (pdf), rotation-logs-202504-202506.zip (zip), kms-rotation-audit.csv (csv)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: secrets rotation and CI/CD handover

Ben / Monica — I reviewed the playbook and logs. A few suggested clarifications for the assessor bundle: 

1) In the playbook, add the snippet showing the GitHub Actions gate that checks secrets freshness (I pasted the workflow excerpt below).
2) Include a short timeline narrative of the blocked deployment (2025-05-12) showing the detection -> block -> remediation steps, with timestamps and responsible on-call contact.
3) For the KMS audit CSV, we should include a hash of the original export for chain-of-custody. I'll generate the SHA256 and add it as a separate text file in the Drive link.

Workflow excerpt (for inclusion):
  - name: Check secrets freshness
    run: |
      python infra/check_secret_freshness.py --service ${{ matrix.service }} || exit 1

If you want, I can prepare the revised docs and push to the Drive folder tonight; otherwise Monica can prep and I'll validate.

Marissa Cole
Manager, Platform Security
---
Internal attachment references: deployment_block_20250512.log (in zip), workflow-excerpt.txt (will add)

From: security_assessor@acmefin.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sig_team@acmefin.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: secrets rotation and CI/CD handover

Hi Ben / Monica / Marissa — this set looks good and addresses the assessor checklist items we discussed. A few small items: 

- Please ensure the sha256 checksum file is present in the Drive link and that the README notes the tokenization approach used in the rotation logs.
- If you can call out the SLOs for secret refresh latency (how long a system can run with a stale secret before we auto-fail deployments), that would be helpful for our risk scoring.

If you can deliver the final Drive bundle by EOD Monday (7/14) we'll slot Redwood into the next SIG review on 7/16. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Lara Mendes
Lead Assessor, Acme FinServ Security
---
